messages:
jamie: Noticed tenant IPs showing up in CP traces over peered links. Need quick pattern to keep per-endpoint metrics but no PII.

marta: Two short options: local telemetry agent that redacts and emits hashed tenant + svc labels, or gateway-side redaction with sampling and route labels.

devin: Agent = best privacy but not possible for cross-account peering. Gateway = one control point but higher PII blast radius if misconfigured.

lina: Agent output should only include tenant_hash, svc_qualifier, region, session_id(opaque). No IP/ports.

kevin: svc_qualifier via SNI is brittle. Support ALPN and explicit agent headers as fallback.

marta: Agree. Also allow operator-provisioned port->svc mapping for legacy customers.

jamie: Ops wants per-endpoint latency histograms but without IPs. Suggest ephemeral session_id mapping created at connection start.

devin: Sketch: agent POST /register -> {session_id, ttl}. Metrics use session_id + tenant_hash. CP keeps ephemeral mapping.

lina: Mapping TTL short (e.g., 60s) and purged. Join only during TTL.

kevin: For cross-account peering we cant inject agents. Options: eBPF/redaction at gateway, or a token-exchange where customer registers expected connections to get telemetry tokens.

marta: Token-exchange is cleaner if customer opts in. Otherwise mark as "unattributed" and sample.

ops-bot: Note: require compliance ticket COMP-2026 before storing tenant identifiers (even hashed).

jamie: Plan: two quick spikes this sprint. Sidecar agent (owner: lina, 2d) and gateway token flow (owner: devin, 3d). Measure latency, token-store QPS, failure modes.

lina: Will prototype Go agent with hashed tenant id and prom push to sandbox.

devin: Will prototype gateway shim that looks up telemetry_token in a fast cache and emits labels; will report p99 overhead.

kevin: Add doc block about default redactions (IP/port/path) and fallback label derivation (ALPN, port map, header).

marta: After spikes, present in arch sync and pick one. :white_check_mark:
